hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; inp=json.load(sys.stdin); path=inp.get('file_path',''); exit(0 if not any(name in path for name in ('infra/mysql/init/00-schema-ddl.sql', 'infra/mysql/init/01-seed-dml.sql')) else 1)" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; echo '[WARN] MySQL 初始化脚本仅在首次容器启动时执行。修改后须运行 docker compose down -v 再重建才能生效。确定继续？按 Ctrl-C 取消，或等待 5 秒继续。' >&2; sleep 5

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; inp=json.load(sys.stdin); path=inp.get('file_path',''); exit(0 if '/common/src/' not in path else 1)" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; echo '[auto] common 模块已变更，正在重新安装...' >&2; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && mvn install -pl common -DskipTests -q && echo '[auto] common install 完成' >&2
